fullText.simplified:
第二十一章、三三的信

    几天后，新闻上出现了最新的报道：梅三三、柳雪迟和孙林记者都已经平安回到家中。孙林记者并没有消失，这是一场误会。他去外地查案了，正是关于“吃人的房子”的案子。现已查明之前两人“消失”的全部经过，这到底是怎么回事呢？请关注我们后续的报道。
    “季平先生，您是不是早就知道真相了。”孙林看完电视上的新闻，转头看向季平，感慨地说道。
    “你指什么？”季平似乎并没有否认。
    “最开始那两个人啊，王克和那个女明星。王克赌博，试图一夜暴富，结果欠了一屁股债，看到两个追债人过来，吓得叫出了声。中介在楼下听到一声大喊，急忙上楼查看。可上楼的脚步声，让王克更加恐惧了。他以为是追债人来了，就躲在了三楼的门后面，所以中介自然没发现他，以为人消失了。女明星，跟我之前推测的一样，听说了有这么个‘吃人的房子’，借助妈妈的掩护，也成功在这里消失了。”孙林把自己跟当事人证实到的结果说给季平听。
    “不错，这说明你之前的推测都是正确的。”季平鼓励孙林，拍拍他的肩膀。
    “您早就看穿了一切。您让我住进三十三号房，是想借助三十三号房的传闻，想办法对付柳也惠和梅放之。”孙林现在也明白了季平的安排。
    季平微笑着说：“我不是说过嘛，谢谢你帮我找到一个一石二鸟的计划，一次性解决掉两个。你是一个好助手！”
    “您跟我讲讲细节呗，我太想知道了！”孙林看着季平，兴致勃勃地问道。
    季平点点头，拿出了两张照片给孙林看。准确说这是两封信，只是被拍了下来。
    这第一封是柳雪迟写给梅三三的信。
    三三：
    自从上个月初，我在阳台上看见了你，那时你对我笑了一下，我就喜欢上了你。我经常去阳台，因为我希望能有机会见到你。
    我的性格比较害羞，不太好意思表达自己。所以当我真的见到你的时候，我又不知道该说什么，只会脸红红地站在那里。
    我找来了我的表哥，希望他能给我出一些主意。他叮嘱我说女孩子都喜欢新奇稀有的东西，比如花啊鱼啊什么的。所以我故意把这些东西放在三楼的阳台上，希望引起你的注意。你知道盒子上的“A33”是什么意思吗？意思是“爱三三”！你一定可以明白我的心的，对吗？
    今天，我下定决心要告诉你这些，所以我给你写了这封信。我想认识你，想跟你说说话。这个星期五下午三点，我在华龙路的公园等你，你可以来见我吗？我有很多话想跟你说。请你一定要答应我！
    柳雪迟
fullText.traditional:
第二十一章、三三的信

    幾天後，新聞上出現了最新的報道：梅三三、柳雪遲和孫林記者都已經平安回到家中。孫林記者並沒有消失，這是一場誤會。他去外地查案了，正是關於“吃人的房子”的案子。現已查明之前兩人“消失”的全部經過，這到底是怎麼回事呢？請關注我們後續的報道。
    “季平先生，您是不是早就知道真相了。”孫林看完電視上的新聞，轉頭看向季平，感慨地說道。
    “你指什麼？”季平似乎並沒有否認。
    “最開始那兩個人啊，王克和那個女明星。王克賭博，試圖一夜暴富，結果欠了一屁股債，看到兩個追債人過來，嚇得叫出了聲。中介在樓下聽到一聲大喊，急忙上樓查看。可上樓的腳步聲，讓王克更加恐懼了。他以為是追債人來了，就躲在了三樓的門後面，所以中介自然沒發現他，以為人消失了。女明星，跟我之前推測的一樣，聽說了有這麼個‘吃人的房子’，借助媽媽的掩護，也成功在這裡消失了。”孫林把自己跟當事人證實到的結果說給季平聽。
    “不錯，這說明你之前的推測都是正確的。”季平鼓勵孫林，拍拍他的肩膀。
    “您早就看穿了一切。您讓我住進三十三號房，是想借助三十三號房的傳聞，想辦法對付柳也惠和梅放之。”孫林現在也明白了季平的安排。
    季平微笑著說：“我不是說過嘛，謝謝你幫我找到一個一石二鳥的計劃，一次性解決掉兩個。你是一個好助手！”
    “您跟我講講細節唄，我太想知道了！”孫林看著季平，興致勃勃地問道。
    季平點點頭，拿出了兩張照片給孫林看。準確說這是兩封信，只是被拍了下來。
    這第一封是柳雪遲寫給梅三三的信。
    三三：
    自從上個月初，我在陽臺上看見了你，那時你對我笑了一下，我就喜歡上了你。我經常去陽臺，因為我希望能有機會見到你。
    我的性格比較害羞，不太好意思表達自己。所以當我真的見到你的時候，我又不知道該說什麼，只會臉紅紅地站在那裡。
    我找來了我的表哥，希望他能給我出一些主意。他叮囑我說女孩子都喜歡新奇稀有的東西，比如花啊魚啊什麼的。所以我故意把這些東西放在三樓的陽臺上，希望引起你的注意。你知道盒子上的“A33”是什麼意思嗎？意思是“愛三三”！你一定可以明白我的心的，對嗎？
    今天，我下定決心要告訴你這些，所以我給你寫了這封信。我想認識你，想跟你說說話。這個星期五下午三點，我在華龍路的公園等你，你可以來見我嗎？我有很多話想跟你說。請你一定要答應我！
    柳雪遲

sentences.simplified: 他叮嘱我说女孩子都喜欢新奇稀有的东西，比如花啊鱼啊什么的。
sentences.traditional: 他叮囑我說女孩子都喜歡新奇稀有的東西，比如花啊魚啊什麼的。
sentences.pinyin: tā dīng zhǔ wǒ shuō nǚ hái zi dōu xǐ huan xīn qí xī yǒu de dōng xi bǐ rú huā ā yú ā shén me de
sentences.english: He advised me that girls all like novel and rare things, such as flowers, fish, and so on.

sentences.simplified: 所以我故意把这些东西放在三楼的阳台上，希望引起你的注意。
sentences.traditional: 所以我故意把這些東西放在三樓的陽臺上，希望引起你的注意。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ wǒ gù yì bǎ zhè xiē dōng xi fàng zài sān lóu de yáng tái shang xī wàng yǐn qǐ nǐ de zhù yì
sentences.english: So I deliberately put these things on the third-floor balcony, hoping to attract your attention.

sentences.simplified: 你知道盒子上的“A33”是什么意思吗？意思是“爱三三”！你一定可以明白我的心的，对吗？
sentences.traditional: 你知道盒子上的“A33”是什麼意思嗎？意思是“愛三三”！你一定可以明白我的心的，對嗎？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ zhī dào hé zi shang de 3 shì shén me yì si ma yì si shì ài sān sān nǐ yí dìng kě yǐ míng bai wǒ de xīn de duì ma
sentences.english: Do you know what the “A33” on the box means? The meaning is “Love Sansan”! You can surely understand my feelings, right?

sentences.simplified: 今天，我下定决心要告诉你这些，所以我给你写了这封信。
sentences.traditional: 今天，我下定決心要告訴你這些，所以我給你寫了這封信。
sentences.pinyin: jīn tiān wǒ xià dìng jué xīn yào gào su nǐ zhè xiē suǒ yǐ wǒ gěi nǐ xiě le zhè fēng xìn
sentences.english: Today, I have made up my mind to tell you these things, so I wrote you this letter.

sentences.simplified: 我想认识你，想跟你说说话。
sentences.traditional: 我想認識你，想跟你說說話。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng rèn shi nǐ xiǎng gēn nǐ shuō shuō huà
sentences.english: I want to get to know you. I want to talk to you.

sentences.simplified: 这个星期五下午三点，我在华龙路的公园等你，你可以来见我吗？
sentences.traditional: 這個星期五下午三點，我在華龍路的公園等你，你可以來見我嗎？
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge xīng qī wǔ xià wǔ sān diǎn wǒ zài huá lóng lù de gōng yuán děng nǐ nǐ kě yǐ lái jiàn wǒ ma
sentences.english: This Friday at 3 pm, I will be waiting for you at the park on Hualong Road. Can you come to meet me?

sentences.simplified: 我有很多话想跟你说。请你一定要答应我！
sentences.traditional: 我有很多話想跟你說。請你一定要答應我！
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yǒu hěn duō huà xiǎng gēn nǐ shuō qǐng nǐ yí dìng yào dā ying wǒ
sentences.english: I have a lot to say to you. You must agree!

sentences.simplified: 柳雪迟
sentences.traditional: 柳雪遲
sentences.pinyin: liǔ xuě chí
sentences.english: Liu Xuechi

sentence_translations: Chapter 21: A Letter to Sansan
A few days later, the latest report appeared in the news: Mei Sansan, Liu Xuechi, and the journalist Sun Lin have all safely returned home.
The reporter Sun Lin had never disappeared; this was a misunderstanding.
He went out of town to investigate a case, specifically the case of the “house that eats people”.
The full details of the previous disappearance of the two people have now been clarified. What exactly happened?
Please stay tuned for our follow-up reports.
“Mr. Ji Ping, did you already know the truth?” Sun Lin said with a sigh, turning to look at Ji Ping after watching the news on TV.
“What do you mean?” Ji Ping seemed not to be denying it.
“At the very beginning, those two people: Wang Ke and that female celebrity.
Wang Ke gambled, trying to get rich overnight, but ended up deep in debt.
When he saw the two debt collectors approaching, he was so scared that he screamed.
The agent, who was downstairs, heard a loud shout and hurriedly went upstairs to check.
The sound of footsteps coming upstairs made Wang Ke even more afraid.
He thought it was the debt collectors, so he hid behind the door on the third floor.
Naturally, the agent didn’t find him and assumed he had disappeared.
The female celebrity, just as I had previously speculated, heard about this ‘house that eats people’.
With her mother covering up for her, she successfully disappeared here as well.”
Sun Lin told Ji Ping the results that he had confirmed with the people concerned.
“Not bad, this shows that your previous speculations were all correct,” Ji Ping encouraged Sun Lin, patting him on the shoulder.
“You saw through everything a long time ago.
You had me move into the house at number thirty-three, ..
.. intending to use the rumors about the house at number thirty-three to find a way to deal with Liu Yehui and Mei Fangzhi.”
Sun Lin now also understood Ji Ping’s arrangements.
Ji Ping smiled and said, ..
.. “Didn’t I tell you? Thank you for helping me find a plan that kills two birds with one stone, solving two problems at once.
You are a good assistant!”
“Tell me the details, I really want to know!” asked Sun Lin with great excitement, looking at Ji Ping.
Ji Ping nodded and took out two photos to show Sun Lin. To be precise, these were two letters that had been photographed.
This first letter was written by Liu Xuechi to Mei Sansan.
Sansan:
Since the beginning of last month, when I saw you on the balcony and you smiled at me, I started to like you.
I often go to the balcony because I hope to have a chance to see you.
I am quite shy by nature and find it difficult to express myself.
So when I actually see you, I don’t know what to say and just stand there blushing.
I brought my cousin over, hoping he could give me some ideas.
He advised me that girls all like novel and rare things, such as flowers, fish, and so on.
So I deliberately put these things on the third-floor balcony, hoping to attract your attention.
Do you know what the “A33” on the box means? The meaning is “Love Sansan”! You can surely understand my feelings, right?
Today, I have made up my mind to tell you these things, so I wrote you this letter.
I want to get to know you. I want to talk to you.
This Friday at 3 pm, I will be waiting for you at the park on Hualong Road. Can you come to meet me?
I have a lot to say to you. You must agree!
Liu Xuechi
